'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021 United Kingdom natural gas supplier crisis]]
**[[Bulb Energy]], which supplies 1.7 million customers in the [[United Kingdom]], collapses into [[administration (law)|administration]], becoming the [[Energy industry|largest energy supplier]] to have ever collapsed. The company will also be the first energy supplier to be placed under "special administration", which means that the company will be run by the [[government of the United Kingdom|government]] regulator [[Ofgem]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2021/nov/22/bulb-energy-which-supplies-17m-customers-collapses-into-administration (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Nine people die in a fire at a nursing home in the village of [[Royak]], [[Dalgopol Municipality]], [[Bulgaria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/fire-nursing-home-bulgaria-kills-9-people-2021-11-22/ (''Reuters'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]] enters its fourth full nationwide [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] that prohibits people from leaving their home except for specific reasons, while allowing schools to remain open, in order to reduce the number of new [[COVID-19]] cases. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-business-health-europe-austria-74a09a4a3c551023029f103c63227130 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[Prime Minister of France|Prime Minister]] [[Jean Castex]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/french-prime-minister-castex-tests-positive-coronavirus-pms-office-2021-11-22/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] begins to implement measures that ban people who are [[COVID-19 vaccination in Greece|unvaccinated]] or who have not recovered from COVID-19 from entering indoor public places and also [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mandates the wearing of masks]] in all workplaces in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1172286/new-restrictions-in-greece-as-pandemic-deaths-mount/ (''Ekathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovakia]]
****[[Slovakia]] imposes a [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] for those who are [[COVID-19 vaccination in Slovakia|unvaccinated]] against COVID-19, which prevents them from entering non-essential shops. Slovakia is currently experiencing one of the world's highest infection rates. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-11-slovakia-lockdown-unvaccinated.html (Medical Xpress)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] begins administering the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] for children between the ages of 5 and 11 years. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-begins-vaccinating-children-aged-5-11/amp/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] partially eases its social gathering restrictions and will allow up to five [[COVID-19 vaccination in Singapore|vaccinated people]] to dine in at food and drink establishments, [[hawker centres]], and coffee shops as the country moves to the endemic phase due to a decrease in the number of new COVID-19 cases. [https://sbr.com.sg/food-beverage/news/singapore-allows-5-person-social-gatherings (Singapore Business Report)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kenya]]
***The [[Kenya]]n [[Government of Kenya|government]] approves a measure requiring people to present proof of [[COVID-19 vaccination in Kenya|vaccination]] in order to enter businesses, restaurants and government offices. This is also to encourage vaccination in a country where only 5% of the population is vaccinated. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/11/22/world/africa/kenya-covid-vaccination-mandate.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Bulgaria–United States relations]], [[Bulgaria–Russia relations]]
**The [[United States]] expresses a "deep concern" over [[President of Bulgaria|Bulgarian President]] [[Rumen Radev]]'s remarks, where he referred to [[Crimea]] as "Russian". Radev has expressed his views of maintaining "pragmatic ties" with [[Russia]]. The statement by the United States comes after [[Ukraine]] summoned the Bulgarian [[ambassador]] to [[Kyiv]] three days ago. [https://www.rferl.org/a/bulgaria-washington-concern-ukraine-crimea-russia/31573009.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Aftermath of the [[2021 Venezuelan regional elections]]
**Opposition leader [[Juan Guaidó]] calls for unity and to rebuild the opposition's fragmented strategy, after suffering a heavy loss at the regional elections and losing 20 gubernatorial races to the ruling [[United Socialist Party of Venezuela]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuela-opposition-says-it-must-rebuild-after-heavy-election-loss-2021-11-22/ (Reuters)]
